fact: The flight over Gracklstugh was chaotic and the party worked to steer Themberchaud toward the docks of the Darklake.
source_quote: The flight over Gracklstugh was anything but graceful. The party worked to steer Themberchaud toward the docks of the Darklake.
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Themberchaud scoffed at the idea of his agents loitering among common rabble and petty traders.
source_quote: At first he scoffed that his agents had better things to do than "loiter among the common rabble and petty traders."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Gyrgum's Persuasion roll was a middling 13, and the help-granted reroll came out worse.
source_quote: Gyrgum's Persuasion roll was a middling 13, and the help-granted reroll came out worse.
subject: Gyrgum's persuasion roll

fact: Themberchaud demonstrated he had no idea where the party should investigate.
source_quote: When Gyrgum asked Themberchaud where he thought they should investigate, it became obvious the dragon had no idea.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Daz suggested dropping the party off at the docks.
source_quote: Daz suggested dropping them there.
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum promised to find the devil in the details.
source_quote: Gyrgum promised to "find the devil in the details."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Zalthir pointed to a recent attack near the docks as a source of fresh intelligence.
source_quote: Zalthir pointed to the recent attack near the docks as a source of fresh intelligence.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Themberchaud's excess weight and lack of recent exercise caused a chaotic, lurching maneuver when he banked into a turn.
source_quote: He was persuaded, but as he banked into a turn, his excess weight and lack of recent exercise made for a chaotic, lurching maneuver.
subject: Themberchaud turns

fact: The chaotic maneuver called for DC 13 Athletics or Acrobatics checks.
source_quote: It called for DC 13 Athletics or Acrobatics checks, and several party members slid off his back.
subject: Athletics/Acrobatics checks

fact: Zalthir sprouted wings after reaching level five.
source_quote: Zalthir, newly level five, sprouted wings
subject: Zalthir

source_quote: sprouted wings and caught the falling Thorin
subject: Zalthir catches Thorin

source_quote: several party members slid off his back. Zalthir, newly level five, sprouted wings and caught the falling Thorin
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin failed his Acrobatics check to stay on the dragon.
source_quote: whose natural 3 and bonus d10 still fell short
subject: Thorin

fact: Daz vanished in a burst of silvery mist and reappeared beside the flying Zalthir.
source_quote: Daz vanished in a burst of silvery mist and reappeared beside the flying Zalthir.
subject: Daz teleports

fact: Jimjar hurled a rope to the tumbling Gyrgum.
source_quote: Jimjar, ever the quick thinker, hurled a rope to the tumbling Gyrgum
subject: Jimjar throws rope

fact: Gyrgum cried out to Bahamut as he fell.
source_quote: who had cried out to Bahamut.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum invoked Bahamut while falling.
source_quote: who had cried out to Bahamut.
subject: Bahamut

fact: Gyrgum caught the rope with a 19 on Acrobatics and was hauled back up.
source_quote: Gyrgum caught it with a 19 on Acrobatics and was hauled back up by the combined effort of his companions.
subject: Gyrgum saved

fact: The air over Gracklstugh is foul and forge-choked.
source_quote: He then made a proud detour to the Forge of Thrazgad... showing off his realm with a series of fly-bys through the foul, forge-choked air.
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: The party passed by the Forge of Thrazgad during a fly-by.
source_quote: He then made a proud detour to the Forge of Thrazgad, where the party roped themselves together just in case.
subject: Forge of Thrazgad

fact: The party tied themselves together with rope as a precaution.
source_quote: where the party roped themselves together just in case.
subject: rope

fact: Themberchaud breathed a torrent of fire to light the Forge of Thrazgad.
source_quote: delivered a booming speech about his own greatness before breathing a torrent of fire to light the forge below.
subject: Themberchaud lights forge

fact: The duergar rolled their eyes at Themberchaud's ego.
source_quote: The duergar below rolled their eyes at his ego.
subject: duergar

fact: The citizens of Gracklstugh looked up in stunned terror at the dragon and the riders.
source_quote: the citizens of Gracklstugh looked up in stunned terror, not just at the dragon but at the figures on his back.
subject: citizens of Gracklstugh

fact: Daz rolled a natural 20 on Insight.
source_quote: Daz rolled a natural 20 on Insight
subject: Daz Insight check

fact: The crowd believed the riders were the Ember Vanguard, agents of the Drow Empire.
source_quote: the crowd believed: the Ember Vanguard, the legendary and feared agents of the Drow Empire, were riding the Wyrmsmith himself.
subject: Ember Vanguard

fact: The Ember Vanguard are identified as agents of the Drow Empire.
source_quote: the legendary and feared agents of the Drow Empire, were riding the Wyrmsmith himself.
subject: Drow Empire

fact: The entire city fell into a panic.
source_quote: The entire city fell into a panic.
subject: city panic

fact: Rumors describe Daz as an 18th-level mage able to cast Meteor Swarm.
source_quote: In rumor, Daz is an 18th-level mage able to cast Meteor Swarm.
subject: Daz

source_quote: The party worked to steer Themberchaud toward the docks of the Darklake.
subject: Darklake

source_quote: Thorin asks how a dragon can fly underground.
subject: Thorin

source_quote: the city sits in a huge cavern, but beyond it are only small tunnels, so Themberchaud cannot really leave.

subject: Thorin

source_quote: Gyrgum floats the idea of being dropped straight into a boat to hijack it.
subject: Gyrgum

source_quote: Themberchaud questions the value of the docks: "What possible intelligence could you uncover there that my vast network doesn't already know?"
subject: Themberchaud

source_quote: Gyrgum gets 12.

source_quote: Thorin rolls a natural 3 +4, then uses a 1d10 boost and still fails.

source_quote: Themberchaud, distraught, flaps harder.

source_quote: Themberchaud lands heavily at the docks.

source_quote: He roars and uses his frightful presence to frighten the local populace.

source_quote: Gyrgum answers, "Aye aye, we will search the docks far and wide,"
